newsitem.title: CANADA: TVX plans to shut down Casa Berardi mine.
newsitem.headline: TVX plans to shut down Casa Berardi mine.

text.p: TVX Gold Inc said on Monday that it and its joint venture partner Golden Knight Resources Inc would suspend mining and milling operations at the Casa Berardi gold mine in Quebec.
"The decision has been taken as a result of continuing operating losses and the need to drill and develop the existing reserves," TVX said in a statement.
The decision would mean a charge to fourth-quarter earnings for both TVX and Vancouver-based Golden Knight, TVX said.
The amount had not yet been determined, but the book value of the mine was US$55 million for TVX and C$58 million for Golden Knight, TVX said.
TVX said it would seek a buyer for the property so operations could continue.
The suspension will be effective in three months, the period required by Quebec legislation.
TVX is the operator and 60 percent-owner of the property.
